explanations: InMemoryRoomInventory.rooms() hands out its own backing list. AvailabilityService treats the returned list as scratch space and calls removeIf and sort on it, so every search permanently deletes booked, wrong-type and too-expensive rooms from the inventory itself. Later searches and the occupancy denominator see the shrunken list. The accessor must return a defensive copy so callers can use the result freely without touching internal state.
